blind.description: A cluster of stylized fantasy mushrooms growing from a circular mound of dark earth bordered by faceted grey stones. The cluster features one tall mushroom, a couple of medium-sized mushrooms, and small budding mushrooms around the base. The stalks and under-gills are pale cream-yellow, while the rounded caps are deep magenta-purple patterned with large pale-yellow spots. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylistically hand-painted.
blind.from_above: An asymmetrical cluster of rounded, spotted purple caps with light cream dots, partially revealing the rocky dirt base underneath on the right and bottom edges.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: low circular mound of soil edged with faceted stones
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 ft tall (a bit over half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 ft in diameter.
